one_liner: Salesforce is a leading enterprise CRM and low-code platform with extensive APIs for data, metadata, automation, analytics, and eventing.
access_notes: Anyone can get a free Developer Edition org and create a Connected App to obtain client ID/secret.
blocker_notes: Customer orgs need API access per edition; Professional requires add-on and Connected App admin approval may be needed.

evidence.quote: For a connected app to request access, it must be integrated with the Salesforce API using the OAuth 2.0 protocol.

Not all Salesforce editions include API access… The following Salesforce editions include API access by default: Enterprise… Unlimited… Developer… Performance… Professional Edition — API is not included by default but can be purchased as an add-on.
Get a Development Environment for Free… Start building on Salesforce for free… Developer Edition.
An outbound message sends information to a designated endpoint… Salesforce sends a SOAP message to this endpoint.
Salesforce MCP Servers connect your AI tools and agents to Salesforce data, metadata, and actions through the open Model Context Protocol (MCP).
